page.layout: One printed page, a title page, all centred lines; no margins, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: Ornamental rule between the author line and the place of printing. The date line is printed as MDCLXIII; the final numeral is read as printed. Some words in the italic line and in the lower block are slightly worn and were read with care; the spelling "Scripturam, docere" and similar forms follow the print.
